contract: A23-79 beta metrics (only always-in-order steps in a funnel: Roblox completes the earlier steps of a later one): funnels LongRoad (Level15/25/30/40/50, Rebirth1; once per account, old saves catch up), DailyVisit (Join, Daily1, Daily3, SetChest, StopCardSeen = the daily card; session = the KST day now, the dailies only while DailyDay is today, a day that turns online starts a new one), Social (InviteSeen, InvitePrompt, InviteSent, InviteeJoined for the inviter, PlayedTogether10m), KingDiary (Page1/3/6/9, caught up), PassShop (ShopOpen = every Shop open = a new GUID session, PassView, PurchasePrompt, Bought from MonetizationService.PassBought); events DaysPlayed (lifetime days, level band, faction), ReturnGap (<6h / 6-24h / 1-3d / 3d+), Attendance, PauseCard, WelcomeBack, FriendJoin, GoToFriend, DiaryPage, CandyTrade, NotifyOptIn, InviteSent, WelcomeBackGo, PromptNearKO (30 s after a KO / failed scroll), KOLeave60 and LeaveContext (KO / StopCard / DailyDone / Combat / Shop / Menu / Idle / Play + session bucket) at the leave; c->s ClientMetric(id, arg) with fixed rules (ready, 0.5 s per id); gold sums per source / sink -> LogEconomyEvent every 5 minutes and at the leave (Gold, SKU = tag, TimedReward / Shop / Gameplay). No UserId, name or free text in any field.
limitations: The real Roblox dashboards are not reached offline (Studio logs nothing). The client sends ClientMetric / UiMetric (game dev 1); MonetizationService.PassBought is game dev 2's signal to add. Signals of the new services are doubles here (their own suites test them).
